prompt:
Photography / Cinematography
Hyper-realistic full-body streetwear fashion portrait of a ruggedly handsome Latino male in his late 20s, with a lean athletic build, closely buzzed dark hair, defined jawline, warm olive skin, and striking model-like facial features. He stands in a relaxed three-quarter pose, weight shifted onto one leg, one hand casually tucked into his pants pocket, and the other hanging naturally at his side. He looks toward the camera with a calm, confident expression. Natural winter afternoon sunlight, realistic skin texture, authentic fabric details, and subtle background depth of field. Vertical 2:3 composition, photographed at eye level with his entire body visible from head to toe.

Environment
A lively urban neighborhood in South Los Angeles on a sunny, cool winter afternoon. A spacious concrete sidewalk and small skate plaza are surrounded by low-rise buildings, palm trees, streetlights, and a few leafless seasonal trees. A large, professionally painted street-art mural featuring a woman's portrait and expressive graphic elements covers a wall in the background. Modest artistic graffiti accents the surrounding concrete surfaces without making the area look messy. Pedestrians walk along the sidewalk, chatting and going about their day. Farther in the background, exactly three skateboarders perform tricks over a metal railing and concrete obstacles. Authentic Southern California street culture, natural pedestrian activity, and believable urban atmosphere.

Pose
The man stands confidently in the foreground, slightly angled toward the camera, with his shoulders relaxed, one hand in his front pants pocket, and the other resting naturally beside his thigh. His feet are positioned apart, with one leg slightly forward. Natural posture, believable anatomy, and an effortless street-fashion editorial presence.

Outfit
Oversized blue, navy, and warm beige plaid flannel overshirt, worn open over a muted slate-blue crewneck T-shirt. Loose-fitting, wide-leg washed charcoal-black jeans with natural fading and a relaxed drape. Classic black leather Dr. Martens lace-up boots with yellow welt stitching. A subtle silver chain necklace and silver ring complete the look. Realistic fabric textures, natural folds, and authentic streetwear styling.

quotedPost.originalText:
PROMPT SHARE: Cold, crisp, sunny fall days are impossible to beat.

#Marketing #Branding #Advertising

Fall sunshine hits different when there's a chill in the air.

Here’s why:

That perfect mix of cool air and warm sunshine makes you want to spend the entire afternoon outside.

Build the moment around a casual neighborhood stroll, letting the character enjoy the atmosphere without forcing a performance.

➜ Image Prompt:

Photography & Cinematography
Ultra-realistic street-fashion photography with a candid New York City editorial aesthetic. Vertical 2:3 composition, full-body framing from head to toe, eye-level perspective, and authentic iPhone 17 Pro photographic quality. A crisp, sunny autumn afternoon with strong directional sunlight, warm highlights, deep natural shadows, and realistic contrast. Subtle analog film grain and slightly muted, earthy color grading create a nostalgic street-photography aesthetic. Preserve natural skin texture, visible pores, individual hair strands, authentic fabric textures, and realistic body proportions. The final image should look like a genuine high-resolution photograph, with no plastic skin, artificial smoothing, CGI appearance, or overly polished AI aesthetics.

Environment
A lively sidewalk in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, on a cool, sunny fall afternoon. Historic red-brick storefronts, weathered building facades, graffiti-covered utility poles, black metal awnings, and neighborhood cafés line the street. A black rectangular sign reading "GOOD PEOPLE BRIGHTER DAYS" hangs from a wooden utility pole on the left side of the composition.

The sidewalk is scattered with golden-brown autumn leaves. Mature trees with sparse yellow and orange foliage frame the street against a clear blue sky. Pedestrians in casual fall clothing walk along the sidewalk, friends gather outside cafés, and cyclists pass through the neighborhood. Parked cars, a blue bicycle, street signs, and a yellow pedestrian crossing signal add authentic urban detail. Bright afternoon sunlight creates long, dramatic shadows across the concrete pavement. The atmosphere feels lively, fashionable, and naturally lived-in.

Pose
An exquisitely beautiful adult female fashion model with warm olive skin, striking almond-shaped brown eyes, naturally full lips, high cheekbones, and refined, symmetrical facial features. Her long, voluminous dark brown hair features subtle caramel highlights, loose natural waves, and a slightly tousled appearance.

She stands confidently in the center of the sidewalk, facing the camera with her weight resting primarily on one leg and her opposite hip subtly angled outward. Her feet are positioned naturally apart, and both hands rest casually inside the pockets of her oversized denim jacket. Her shoulders are relaxed, and her head is held upright as she looks directly into the camera with a calm, self-assured expression. Her posture feels effortless and spontaneous, like a candid street-fashion photograph.

Outfit
An oversized, faded medium-blue denim jacket with a cropped, boxy silhouette, dropped shoulders, voluminous sleeves, a structured collar, metallic buttons, and large chest pockets. The jacket is worn partially buttoned over a fitted white scoop-neck top.

High-waisted, oversized khaki cargo pants in a warm beige tone, featuring a relaxed wide-leg silhouette, large side utility pockets, visible stitching, and natural fabric creases. The pants drape loosely over her shoes, with slight bunching around the ankles.

Classic off-white canvas low-top sneakers with white rubber toe caps, white laces, and thin black detailing along the soles.

A large natural-cream canvas tote bag hangs from her left shoulder, resting against her hip. Gold hoop earrings, a delicate gold chain necklace, and a second necklace with a small cross pendant complete the look. Natural, understated makeup emphasizes her eyes, cheekbones, and lips while preserving authentic skin texture.

translations.zh:
摄影 / 电影质感
超写实全身街头时尚肖像，主角是一位二十多岁、体格精瘦健硕的硬朗英俊拉丁裔男子，留寸头深发，下颌分明，橄榄肤色，五官俊朗。呈放松的四分之三侧身姿态，重心单腿，一手插兜，神情镇定自信。自然冬日下午阳光，质感皮肤与面料细节，微景深，竖幅2:3眼平构图。

环境
阳光明媚的冬日下午，洛杉矶南部热闹的街区步道与小滑板广场，低矮建筑、棕榈树与涂鸦壁画环绕，远处有滑板少年与路人，南加街头氛围真实生动。

姿势
男子在前置站立，肩膀放松，步态自然，呈现毫不费力的街拍感。

着装
宽松蓝灰与暖米色格纹法兰绒衬衫内搭蓝灰圆领T恤，宽松洗水炭黑牛仔裤，经典黑色马丁靴配黄色缝线，细银链与银戒指点缀。
